acceptance.assertion: fleet/repos.yml remains the only normative Fleet membership source. A versioned Renovate rollout policy and deterministic scope projection are validated against active projectable Fleet repositories; archived-reference and fleet:false repositories are rejected and no independent complete Fleet list becomes authoritative.

Metarepo contains a versioned central Renovate V1 preset that disables automerge, bounds PR concurrency and cadence, groups compatible patch/minor updates, isolates major updates, and preserves existing GitHub/CI and Grabowski head/diff/review merge gates.

Validation fails closed when one repository/dependency scope would be assigned overlapping Renovate and Dependabot version-update producers. V1 keeps Dependabot Security Updates conceptually separate from version-update ownership and does not disable security alerts.

The policy encodes bounded rollout waves. Default-branch consumer configuration changes remain separate follow-up work; source-bound Event 1823 additionally permits the central runtime to create bounded Renovate update branches and pull requests without merge or automerge authority.
No all-repository Mend-hosted installation is accepted in V1. The verified implementation uses the explicitly scoped self-hosted runtime and no Mend application.

The 2026-06-23 through 2026-07-23 baseline of 51 Dependabot PRs, 40 merged and 11 closed-unmerged is stored as dated comparison evidence with per-repository counts where available, without asserting Renovate improvement before measurement.
Material runtime follow-ups are registered through operator-native Bureau intake. The Python-3.10 test-contract and future multi-lockfile issues are registered as T079 and T080.

The Metarepo foundation remains independently reversible. The Event-1823 runtime refinement is separately reversible by disabling the timer and restoring the previous immutable runtime release; it grants no merge, automerge, Mend-app, PAYG or direct-main authority.

A clean immutable self-hosted Renovate runtime is installed from the exact reviewed Metarepo merge commit. A full lookup dry-run and a bounded writing run complete across the deterministic 18-repository Fleet scope with exit code 0 while automerge remains disabled.

The real systemd service completes successfully and the daily timer is enabled and waiting. Post-effect GitHub readback shows Renovate branches and pull requests but no autoMergeRequest and no direct default-branch mutation.

approval.note: The original 2026-07-23 directive authorized the reviewed Fleet-bound Renovate foundation. Source-bound Candidate candidate-4238aa9b268efe0ee5b53843 / Event 1823 later explicitly refined T046 to include immutable runtime installation, bounded dry and writing runs, timer activation and revisionsgebundener closeout after foreign Metarepo work became terminal. No Mend/PAYG or automerge authority was granted.

goal: Establish the canonical Fleet-bound Renovate V1 policy and rollout contract in Metarepo and, under the later source-bound Event-1823 refinement, activate its immutable self-hosted runtime on the Heim-PC. The runtime may create bounded Renovate update branches and pull requests across the deterministic Fleet scope, but it may not merge, automerge, enable a hosted Mend application, use PAYG capacity or mutate consumer default branches directly.

does_not_establish: a Mend-hosted Renovate application is installed
all generated dependency updates are correct or mergeable
consumer default branches were directly changed by the runtime
permission to override foreign leases or dirty worktrees
metadata.known_catalog_gap: Historical source context: repo.mitschreiber was absent from the Bureau repository-resource catalog when T046 was registered; the verified runtime scope is derived from current fleet/repos.yml rather than an invented second Fleet.
metadata.registered_from: User directive 2026-07-23 after system-wide Renovate architecture review; runtime activation and T046 closeout were added by source-bound Event 1823.

supersedes_prior_decision.scope: The reviewed Fleet-bound foundation and bounded self-hosted runtime activation are authorized. Default-branch consumer configuration migrations remain separately gated.

contract_refinement.superseded_boundary: The original foundation-only boundary did not itself authorize runtime activation. Event 1823 explicitly merged the missing runtime activation and T046 closeout into this task after the foreign Metarepo lease became terminal.

verification.outcome_summary: Fleet-bound Renovate V1 is implemented and its immutable self-hosted runtime is active. The deterministic 18-repository scope completed both lookup and bounded writing execution successfully; the service and timer are healthy, automerge remains disabled, and material residual issues are registered as T079 and T080.

rollback.strategy: Revert the Metarepo foundation commits independently. For the Event-1823 runtime refinement, disable renovate-fleet.timer, stop any active renovate-fleet.service execution, restore the previous immutable release and launcher binding from the install backup, and leave already-created Renovate pull requests subject to normal review or closure. Do not rewrite consumer default branches or enable automerge during rollback.

title: Establish Fleet-bound Renovate V1 policy and rollout contract
